content.short: Sushi is a multichain decentralized exchange for swapping cryptocurrency tokens.
content.description: Sushi is an automated market maker that enables swapping between different cryptocurrencies and tokens through automated liquidity pools across EVM-compatible blockchain networks and Layer-2 solutions. This design supports a wide array of assets and trading activity across multiple ecosystems, reflecting Sushi’s standing as one of the largest DeFi platforms. Over time, Sushi has expanded its DeFi offerings using its native token SUSHI.
content.meta: Sushi is a multichain decentralized exchange focused on swapping cryptocurrency tokens. Discover Sushi and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
